{{color2|000|Pokémon X and Y|X and Y}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Wikstrom/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Wikstrom anime.png|thumb|250px|Wikstrom in {{aniseries|JN}}]] ====''[[M17|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction]]''==== Wikstrom debuted in ''[[M17|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction]]'' as part of the ''World of Pokémon'' intro. During his cameo, he was seen in a battle with [[Diantha]]. ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== Wikstrom made his main series debut in ''[[JN056|Searching for Chivalry!]]''. {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] traveled to [[Kalos]] to participate in a training camp hosted by Wikstrom at the [[Castle of Chivalry]]. Wikstrom had the boys traverse through a variety of obstacle courses while wearing armor and defending themselves from Wikstrom's Pokémon. Ash and Goh eventually completed all of the challenges and earned Knight Medals for both themselves and their Pokémon. He also helped Goh evolve his {{p|Scyther}} into {{TP|Goh|Scizor}} by giving it a [[Metal Coat]] and transferring it through a [[trade machine]]. In ''[[JN060|Beyond Chivalry… Aiming to be a Leek Master!]]'', [[Rinto]] revealed that he also trained at the Castle of Chivalry. During Rinto's battle with Ash, Ash used some of what he learned from Wikstrom to be able to win the battle. In ''[[JN103|The Future is Now, Thanks to Strategy!]]'', Wikstrom was briefly seen battling [[Drasna]] at the Castle of Chivalry. In ''[[JN104|Taking Two For The Team!]]'', he met Ash prior to his [[World Coronation Series]] battle against Drasna in [[Lumiose City]] and saw that Ash's {{p|Farfetch'd}} had evolved into {{AP|Sirfetch'd}} since their last meeting. He later watched the battle and congratulated Ash after he had won it. In ''[[JN130|Toying With Your Motions!]]'', Wikstrom watched Ash's match against {{an|Leon}} in the [[Masters Eight Tournament]] finals, shedding tears at witnessing Sirfetch'd's chivalrous performance. ====Character==== True to his appearance, Wikstrom is very chivalrous in his mannerisms and choice of words, though is also very kind and offers support to anyone who seeks it. He believes in upholding the standards of chivalry in all aspects of life, as he believes chivalry to be the best method to achieve greater strength. In battle, whether it be a Pokémon battle or a fight with sword props, he attacks bravely and strives to overwhelm his opponent. Wikstrom also a strong supporter of youth, opening the Castle of Chivalry to provide young Trainers with a training ground to grow stronger and wiser. Wikstrom is also prone to sudden bursts of extreme and joyous crying when witnessing something truly chivalrous, something that provides humor and concern alike to those around him. ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Wikstrom's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Wikstrom |pkmn=Scizor |mega=yes |type1=Bug |type2=Steel |img=Wikstrom Mega Scizor.png |cap=Wikstrom's Mega Scizor |epnum=M17 |epname=Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction |vajp= |vaen= |desc=Wikstrom used his {{p|Scizor}} in a battle against [[Diantha's Gardevoir]], with both Pokémon [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolved]]. إبراهيم ماضي ''Ibrahim Madi'' ([[JN103]]-[[JN104]]) | fi = Jukka Pihlajaniemi | he = אליעזר וייס ''Eliezer Weiss'' | it = Massimiliano Lotti | pl = Tomasz Steciuk | pt_br = Ronaldo Júlio | es_la = Beto Castillo | es_eu = Pablo Adán | no = Lars Dahl Dova | da = Rasmus Hammerich | ca = Jordi Filbà }} ===GOTCHA!=== Wikstrom briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== [[File:Wikstrom Adventures.png|thumb|150px|Wikstrom in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Wikstrom debuts in ''[[PS587|Malamar Traps]]''. He first appears as a fantasy when Diantha informed [[Korrina]] about each of the Kalos Elite Four. He later debuts in person alongside Drasna, where he assists {{adv|X}} and {{adv|Y}}'s group in their quest to stop Team Flare. With his {{p|Probopass}}'s magnetic abilities, Wikstrom created guides in the road to help X's group travel to Team Flare's hiding place. Later, Wikstrom battles against members of Team Flare at {{rt|20|Kalos}}. After Team Flare is fully defeated, Wikstrom, the remaining Elite Four members, and Diantha carry the unconscious body of [[Malva]], who had turned out to be a member of Team Flare. ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Probopass 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Wikstrom |width=80 |pkmn=Probopass |type1=Rock |type2=Steel |img=Wikstrom Probopass Adventures.png |epnum=PS587 |epname=Malamar Traps |desc={{p|Probopass}} is Wikstrom's only known Pokémon. It was first used to help {{adv|X}} and his friends on their way to Team Flare's hiding place. By using its magnetism to pull ore from the ground, Probopass made guides in the road to lead X and his friends on their way. Probopass's only known move is {{m|Magnet Bomb}}.}} [[File:Wikstrom JNM.png|thumb|200px|Wikstrom in Pokémon Journeys]] ===Pokémon Journeys=== Wikstrom appeared in a flashback in ''[[JNM18|Beyond Chivalry… Aiming to Be a Leek Master!]]''. Just like in {{aniseries|JN}}, Wikstrom trained Ash and Goh at some point before the events of the chapter. ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Aegislash 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Wikstrom |pkmn=Aegislash |type1=Steel |type2=Ghost |img=Wikstrom Aegislash JNM.png |epnum=JNM18 |epname=Beyond Chivalry… Aiming to Be a Leek Master! |vajp= |vaen= |desc= {{p|Aegislash}} appeared in a flashback alongside Wikstrom, it is assumed that {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] battled him like in {{aniseries|JN}}. According to Ash, Aegislash represented the meaning of "knight".
